items.title: Disclosure sidecar table exists
items.description: DuckDB contains official_disclosure_item and bootstrap seeds deterministic development rows.

items.title: Sync writes disclosure sidecar
items.description: market_data.sync writes official_disclosure_item rows and marks the artifact READY in both fixture-backed and live CNInfo-backed flows.

items.title: Stock disclosures API is available
items.description: The backend exposes a stock disclosures payload with snapshot-bound as-of semantics.

items.title: Workbench renders official disclosures
items.description: The frontend reads the disclosures payload and renders an official disclosure panel in stock detail.

items.title: Disclosure events include body, classification, inquiry, and dedupe fields
items.description: official_disclosure_item includes disclosure_event_id, disclosure_event_type, body_summary, classification_explanation, inquiry_status, reply_status, and related_announcement_id, with docs/generated/db-schema.md refreshed.

items.title: Stock disclosures read path returns deduplicated events
items.description: The stock disclosures API returns event-level rows with source, disclosure time, summary, classification, inquiry/reply status, and effective snapshot binding.

items.title: Workbench renders disclosure event context
items.description: The stock detail disclosure panel shows event category, disclosure time, summary, source, inquiry/reply status, and snapshot binding.
